speaker: ALICE
description: A young adult female with a soft, warm, and sweet timbre. Her voice moves at a light, measured pace with a gently amused and affectionate emotional baseline. ref_text: Shall we sleep together? It’s the last night, and I feel a bit lonely without you nearby.
